title: 1D Beam - Bending Analysis (FEM)
desc.intro: Extended version of problem 5.2.5 (course notes) with a full bending analysis using Euler-Bernoulli beam finite elements. Includes several load types, boundary conditions, variable properties and complete analyses.
desc.features.title: Features
desc.features.loads.label: Loads
desc.features.loads: Uniform, linear, triangular, sinusoidal, point load
desc.features.bc.label: Boundary conditions
desc.features.bc: Simply supported, cantilever, fixed-fixed, propped cantilever
desc.features.props.label: Variable properties
desc.features.analyses.label: Analyses
desc.features.presets.label: Preset cases
desc.features.presets: Concrete beam, steel beam, cantilever roof, bridge beam
desc.eq.title: Differential equation
desc.eq.text: where w is the vertical deflection, E(x) the variable Young's modulus, I(x) the variable moment of inertia and q(x) the distributed load.
desc.ana.title: Analytical solution
desc.ana.text: Available only for constant properties (constant E and I) and uniform load. For variable properties, only the FEM provides the numerical solution.
note.analytical_only: Available only for constant properties and uniform load
result.title: Analysis results
result.note.full.label: Full analysis
result.note.full: Deflections, load, material properties, bending moments and shear forces
